{{Quote|So, Captain, you're telling me I missed the whole mission?''"<br />"''Don't worry, Toomer, there's plenty more fighting to come.|Toomer and Rex|<ref name="Shipyards" />}}
'''Toomer''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Toomer was a member of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led Republic strike team that went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gwori]] in an attempt to pinpoint the location of local [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Gwori shipyards|shipyards]] and target them for [[Battle of Gwori|destruction]] for a Republic assault force. In order to bypass the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the world, Toomer and the rest of the team were [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] slabs. This helped to hide the presence of biological organisms from the droid [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] scanners while the infiltrators were [[Transport/Legends|transported]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[VX-391]]'', [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

The team passed through the blockade, but, upon reaching the planet, the freighter was attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. R2-D2 safely ejected the slabs from the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] before its destruction, and the team reached the ground, but the controls on Toomer's carbonite block were damaged in the fall. As a result, he was unable to be unfrozen from his slab for the duration of the mission. He was later unfrozen on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], after the mission had already been completed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The controls on Toomer's block got busted in the drop. This mean he's stuck in there?''"<br />"''For now. Move him under some cover. We'll come back for him later.|Rex and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Shipyards" />}}
Toomer was the taken name<ref name="Shipyards" /> of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="databank" /> Toomer served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the war escalated, it became apparent that the Confederacy had an advantage in the number of [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after a series of Republic defeats in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] proposed to strike at the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Gwori shipyards|shipyards]] on the planet [[Gwori]]. Because of the tight security on Gwori, the Jedi did not know where exactly on the planet the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] were located, and it was decided to send a small strike team there to pinpoint the shipyards' location to the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Toomer was among the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] chosen for the mission.<ref name="Shipyards" />

[[File:Toomer_frozen.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rex, inspecting Toomer's damaged slab]]
However, Gwori was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-only zone, meaning that only droid-piloted [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were allowed to reach the planet. Each transport passing through the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the world was [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] with [[Death/Legends|deadly]] rays that killed all living organisms should any be found. To this end, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] proposed to infiltrate the planet by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|freezing]] the strike team in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], which would hide them from the droid scanners. Inside [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbonite-freeze plant]] [[CT-642]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Toomer was subjected to the freezing procedure alongside Skywalker; his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]; and two other clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]. The carbonite slabs containing the strike team were then loaded onto the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[VX-391]]'', and Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] it to Gwori by [[Slicer/Legends|hijacking]] a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and controlling all his actions. Once they reached Gwori, the transport successfully passed the radiation check and headed toward the planet. However, when R2-D2 failed to land the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] at [[Platform A-61]] as he had been instructed&mdash;since the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was unaware where it was located&mdash;the shipyards' [[Overseer/Legends|overseer]], [[Juhm]], realized that ''VX-391'' was not a Confederate vessel and ordered his forces to open fire at it.<ref name="Shipyards" />

As [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] swarmed the ship, R2-D2 released the cargo locks, ejecting the carbonite blocks onto the ground before escaping himself. ''VX-391'' was destroyed, and Juhm presumed that he had killed the enemy. R2-D2 helped unfreeze all members of the strike force, except Toomer, whose slab controls had been damaged in the fall. The Jedi moved Toomer to a safe location and continued on their mission, eventually reporting the shipyards' coordinates to the Republic. Later, as the Republic's [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] led the [[Battle of Gwori|attack]] on the shipyards, the three Jedi and Rex&mdash;the two other troopers having been killed in the course of the mission&mdash;attempted to escape from the planet on a commandeered Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. Before leaving Gwori, Skywalker activated the ship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], bringing the still frozen Toomer aboard. The shipyards were destroyed, and Skywalker safely piloted the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to Coruscant, where Toomer was successfully unfrozen. He was disappointed to discover that he had missed the entire mission, but Rex told him that there were still many battles to be fought.<ref name="Shipyards" />

==Personality and traits==
Toomer displayed considerable disappointment over the fact that he had missed all the action on Gwori.<ref name="Shipyards" /> Like all clone troopers, Toomer had the same height as their genetic template Jango Fett, 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="databank" /> The trooper had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Shipyards" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toomer appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]'', a [[2008]] [[Star Wars comic books|graphic-novella]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]].<ref name="Shipyards" />
